movelist.name: Fling
movelist.effect: The user throws a held item, determining the effect of Fling.

movelist.name: Encore
movelist.effect: Roll 1d6. On a result of 1 or 2, the target becomes Confused; on a result of 3 or 4 the target becomes Suppressed; on a result of 5 or 6 the target becomes Enraged.

movelist.name: Roost
movelist.effect: The user regains Hit Points equal to half of its full Hit Points. If the user is a Flying Type, it loses the Flying Type until the start of their next turn.

movelist.name: Karate Chop
movelist.effect: Karate Chop is a Critical Hit on 17+.

abilities.name: Unburden
abilities.effect: The default state of the user’s Speed is +2 Combat Stages. While holding a Held Item, the user’s Speed is lowered by 2 Combat Stages.

abilities.name: Keen Eye
abilities.effect: The user’s Accuracy cannot be lowered, their attacks cannot have Accuracy Penalties (such as from Illuminate), the user is immune to the Blind condition (but not Total Blindness), and the user ignores any Evasion not directly derived from Stats (such as from the Instinct Ability, or from moves like Minimize).
